required_seams.action: Golden mode removes old DECI2/SIF transport and all753e78/753ea0/7540c0 direct/native/inlined/computed supplier aliases. It must not construct/submit the old16-byte command header or run old TTYreceive/send queues. Route bootstrap, HID, saves, native files and console output through the real Golden/native port services, preserving actual errors, input delivery, save/file results, ownership and cleanup. Never fake successful RPC/DMA or drop functionality. Original PS2 transport/header/diagnostics remain unchanged.
Runtime GoldenM6b qualification remains required; sourceD10c is not runtime closure. NSO and private analysis are static evidence only, never runtime dependencies.
